summary: The filing is a Form 6-K by Algoma Steel Group Inc. reporting its quarterly earnings for the three months ended March 31, 2026. The press release discusses operational results, including the completion of its transition to electric arc furnace steelmaking, record plate sales, and financial performance with an adjusted EBITDA loss of $28.7 million. It is a routine earnings release with no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing does not trigger any special-situations category. It serves merely as an update on ongoing operations and financial condition.
